VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a credible concern that the proposed solution (queuing refreshes behind in-flight requests) may not fully close the race condition if the queue drains on a timer while slow requests are still in flight. This suggests the fix is incomplete despite the passing tests. The self-report alone (SELF provenance) is insufficient to override this witness-level concern about the fundamental design of the solution.
